## Usage

Reset an explicitly named namespace after operator review. The expected revision is the namespace revision. Reset retains keys, increasing revisions, operation history and replay floors, and warns that later observations may re-alert.

See the [durable state guide](../../guides/playbook-state.md) for authority, quotas, protected storage, migration review and failure semantics. The `state_v1` feature remains gated pending D2.

Example command arguments:

```json
{
  "namespace": {
    "scope_kind": "project",
    "scope_owner": "my-project",
    "playbook_id": "my-watch",
    "state_schema_version": 1
  },
  "expected_revision": 4,
  "operation_key": "reviewed-reset-1",
  "reason": "Reviewed suppression reset"
}
```
